verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API for use in your own case management system. It also offers webhooks for workflow completion, a case audit-trail endpoint, case exports and external-identifier customer lookup, which together support pushing and pulling investigation state. However, the evidence does not show webhook events for case or decision changes, nor an explicit bidirectional sync or conflict-handling mechanism, so continuous synchronization of decisions is only implied. missing for 10: documented case/decision-change webhook events, explicit two-way sync guidance (e.g., writing case decisions back via API), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system

citations.quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
